messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager 7248 triggered — high 5xx rate from /v1/generation, aggregated error spike in eu-west-1.
Maria K.: i'm primary for tonight but i'm on a train for the next 30m. can someone pick up the bridge pls?
Devin R.: i'm async for the evening but can shadow until 22:30 UTC. what's the customer impact?
IncidentBot: customer-impact: 3 customers with >50% failed requests, degradation in streaming connections.
Maria K.: client A / B are seeing partial failures, client C has retries and increased latency. service still responding for most requests.
Sasha T.: i can take primary immediately if needed. currently in the US-east timezone though — will be awake.
Kevin L.: i can be secondary. i'm nearby and can jump into the runbook.
Maria K.: thanks @Sasha @Kevin. Sasha — if you take primary, please ack the pager and set the bridge.
Sasha T.: acked. creating bridge now.
Sasha T.: @channel i've created a temporary zoom bridge: https://zoom.us/j/999999999 (pw: aurora). i'm primary now. handing off badge in rotator.
Devin R.: congrats handoff. quick note: if you see KV-cache OOM on the model worker, follow the "evict-prefix-cache" steps in runbook.
Maria K.: runbook link: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/serving/kv-cache-oom (see the section "fast fallback -> smaller batch sizes").
Kevin L.: copying critical commands for convenience:
```
# reduce batching and restart worker gracefully
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://infra-api.internal/redwood/scale -d '{"worker":"model-serve-1","batch_size":8}'
# restart worker
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-worker -n serving-eu
```
Sasha T.: seeing logs, pattern matches prefix cache exhaustion on worker-3. applying scale-down of batch_size now.
Sasha T.: applied batch_size=8, tailing logs. errors dropping but some 10s of requests still failing.
Maria K.: if errors persist after 5m, fallback policy is to route non-critical traffic to a cheaper model variant (m-cpu-small). That is in the routing policy under /ops/routing.
Devin R.: i'm updating the incident channel with customer-facing note, no public outage at the moment but degraded UX for streams.
Oncall Helper Bot: Reminder: update "oncall-handoff" doc when leaving shift: https://intra.redwood/policies/oncall-handoff
Sasha T.: noted. Kevin, can you be secondary and monitor for 30m? i'll stay on bridge until the rate normalizes.
Kevin L.: on it. watching logs + synthetic checks. will escalate to infra if backend mem climbs >80%.
Maria K.: ETA for me to fully rejoin: 40m. i'll stay available by DMs for context.
Sasha T.: thanks. quick checklist before closing thread: 1) acked pager (done) 2) bridge up (done) 3) batch_size reduced (done) 4) error rate trending down but still elevated 5) secondary assigned (Kevin) 6) customer communications queued (Devin)
Devin R.: queued message sent to affected accounts; support loop created.
Sasha T.: error rate down to baseline after 12m. continuing to monitor for 20m. will update when stable for 30m.
Kevin L.: no new alerts in the last 5m. infra mem steady at 65%.
Maria K.: thanks everyone. Sasha — if you need an extra hand later ping me. i'll mark this in the oncall notes on the rota.
Sasha T.: thanks all — closing bridge in 25m if no regression. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Pager 7248 resolved by user Sasha T. (1854322179).
Sasha T.: closing thread. final status: mitigation applied (batch_size reduction), temporary bridge, secondary monitoring, customers notified, follow-up ticket filed: INT-3456.
Maria K.: noted INT-3456. postmortem not required unless regression.
Kevin L.: filing a short runbook addendum about the edge-case we hit.
Devin R.: ack.
